{{Quote|Choose from regular or half-caf, freshly ground and brewed. Bantha cream and Christophsian sugar available upon request.|Dex's Diner menu, on its caf|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Half-caf''' was a way in which the [[Foodstuff/Legends|beverage]] [[Caf/Legends|caf]] could be served. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] served freshly ground and brewed half-caf, with [[Bantha cream]] and [[Christophsian sugar/Legends|Christophsian sugar]] available to add in, for 1.3 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Half-caf was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
